questions.prompt: Choose the response that best addresses this independent task: Foundation · 1 OF 3 Give the final array after int[] a={8,4,2}; a[1]=a[0]-a[2];
options: A record groups related named fields with different types, such as string Name and int Mark; a homogeneous array alone does not describe those two fields clearly.
A tuple such as (string name,int score) can return two related values quickly; a named record is usually clearer when the structure is a long-lived domain entity.
